The terms the DPI-H for Health workshop's policy-maker track hands every table, in plain language. Where the [DPI-H Reference Architecture](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/dpi-h-ra/index.html) glossary (smart-ra) defines the same or a close concept, the term is smart-ra's and so is the definition, word for word; elsewhere the definition is the handout's ([the handout, PDF](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf)). Each term also links to the Digital Transformation Handbook for Primary Health Care glossary (dth-phc) where it has one.

*Definition from* says whose words the definition is, and links to them: the handout (PDF) or the DPI-H RA glossary. *Also defined in* links the same concept in the DPI-H RA, DTH-PHC and SMART Trust glossaries. *same as*: both glossaries mean the same thing. *close to*: nearly the same. *covers*: this term covers several of theirs. *related*: it only touches theirs. Every term is a candidate until a person adopts it.

### Infrastructure and architecture

| Term | Definition | Definition from | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-digital-public-infrastructure"></a>**Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)** | A set of shared digital systems that should be secure and interoperable, and can be built on open standards and specifications to deliver and provide equitable access to public and/or private services at societal scale and are governed by applicable legal frameworks and enabling rules to drive development, inclusion, innovation, trust, and competition, while respecting human rights and fundamental freedoms. (G20/UNDP) | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/digital-public-infrastructure/) |  |  |
| <a id="term-dpi-for-health"></a>**Health Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI-H)** | Health Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI-H) refers to digital resources that are built as a shared means for fulfilling multiple health agency functions. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/health-digital-public-infrastructure/) |  |  |
| <a id="term-foundational-dpi"></a>**Foundational Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI-F)** | Foundational Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI-F) is the digital public infrastructure, such as identity, payments and data exchange, upon which the health sector can build. DPI-H is distinct from DPI-F and builds on it. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/foundational-digital-public-infrastructure/) |  |  |
| <a id="term-reference-architecture"></a>**Reference Architecture** | A technology-neutral blueprint that captures the common building blocks, relationships, and design principles of a technical environment. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/reference-architecture/) | 2 |  |
| <a id="term-point-of-service-application"></a>**Point-of-Service Applications** | Point-of-service applications are end-user application components (IT systems or software tools) used by individuals directly engaged in healthcare—such as clinicians, community health workers, and patients—that enable interaction with the broader healthcare ecosystem. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/point-of-service-applications/) |  |  |
| <a id="term-application-programming-interface"></a>**Application programming interface (API)** | A defined, documented way for one system to ask another for data. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Application programming interface](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/application-programming-interface/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: Application programming interface](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/application-programming-interface/) |
| <a id="term-client-registry"></a>**Client Registry** | The Client Registry is the national authoritative source of health-specific person identity. It is the foundational health-sector component that maintains a unique, verifiable identity record for every person who accesses or is eligible to access health services within a jurisdiction. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/client-registry/) |  | close to [DPI-H RA: Master patient index](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/master-patient-index/) |
| <a id="term-facility-workforce-and-product-registries"></a>**Facility, workforce and product registries** | Authoritative lists of health facilities, health workers, and products such as vaccines and their batches. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | covers [DPI-H RA: Health facility registry](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/health-facility-registry/)<br/>covers [DPI-H RA: Health workforce registry](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/health-workforce-registry/)<br/>covers [DPI-H RA: Product registry](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/product-registry/) |
| <a id="term-lifelong-health-record"></a>**Lifelong Health Record** | The Lifelong Health Record (LHR) is one or more governed data repositories, whether physically consolidated or virtually federated, that collectively maintain a longitudinal, person-centred record of an individual's key health information across care settings and over their lifetime. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/lifelong-health-record/) |  | close to [DPI-H RA: Shared health record](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/shared-health-record/) |
| <a id="term-electronic-immunization-registry"></a>**Electronic immunization registry (EIR)** | Records each person's doses. Often the first working part of a lifelong record. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | related [DPI-H RA: Lifelong health record](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/lifelong-health-record/)<br/>related [DPI-H RA: Registry](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/registry/) |
| <a id="term-personal-health-record"></a>**Personal health record (PHR)** | Health information the person can see and control, for example in a wallet or citizen app. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Personal health record](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/personal-health-record/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: Personal health record](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/personal-health-record/) |
| <a id="term-terminology-service"></a>**Terminology Service** | The Terminology Service is a governed, publicly accessible service that manages, publishes, and provides access to the standardised terminologies, code systems, value sets, and concept maps used across the digital health ecosystem. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/terminology-service/) |  |  |
| <a id="term-logical-information-model"></a>**Logical information model** | The agreed structure of the data: elements, types and rules, independent of any software. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | related [DPI-H RA: Logical information model repository](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/logical-information-model-repository/) |
| <a id="term-decision-support-engine"></a>**Computable Decision Support Engine** | The Computable Decision Support Engine is a governed, shared application component that delivers context-appropriate, evidence-based guidance at the point of clinical decision-making by applying computable clinical rules and knowledge artefacts to person-specific health data. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/computable-decision-support-engine/) |  | related [DTH-PHC: Decision support system](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/decision-support-system/)<br/>related [DTH-PHC: Decision support logic](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/decision-support-logic/) |
| <a id="term-health-information-exchange"></a>**Health information exchange (HIE)** | The layer that routes data securely between systems. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Health information exchange](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/health-information-exchange/) |
| <a id="term-health-management-information-system"></a>**Health Management Information System (HMIS)** | The Health Management Information System is a governed, shared application component responsible for the systematic collection, aggregation, analysis, and dissemination of population-level and facility-level health data to support health system planning, performance monitoring, resource allocation, and policy decision-making. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/health-management-information-system/) |  | same as [DTH-PHC: Health management information system](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/health-management-information-system/) |
| <a id="term-civil-registration-and-vital-statistics"></a>**Civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS)** | Birth registration can start a child's immunization record. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Civil registration and vital statistics](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/civil-registration-and-vital-statistics/) |
| <a id="term-interoperability"></a>**Interoperability** | Interoperability is the standards-based capability of heterogeneous information systems to communicate, exchange data, and use the exchanged information to execute functions effectively. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/interoperability/) |  | same as [DTH-PHC: Interoperability](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/interoperability/) |

### Standards and specifications

| Term | Definition | Definition from | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-standard-vs-specification"></a>**Standard vs specification** | A standard is a general rulebook (FHIR). A specification says exactly how to apply it to one use case (the ICVP IG). | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | related [DPI-H RA: Open standards](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/open-standards/)<br/>related [DTH-PHC: Interoperability standards](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/interoperability-standards/) |
| <a id="term-smart-guidelines"></a>**SMART Guidelines** | Standards-based, Machine-readable, Adaptive, Requirements-based, Testable Guidelines are a comprehensive set of reusable digital health components (e.g., interoperability standards, code libraries, algorithms, technical and operational specifications) that transform the guideline adaptation and implementation process to preserve fidelity and accelerate uptake. SMART Guidelines provide a five-step pathway to advance the adoption of best clinical and data practices, even if a country is not yet fully digital. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/smart-guidelines/) |  | same as [DTH-PHC: Smart guidelines](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/smart-guidelines/) |
| <a id="term-smart-levels"></a>**SMART levels L1–L5** | L1 narrative guideline · L2 DAK · L3 machine-readable FHIR IG · L4 reference software · L5 dynamic, data-driven use. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | related [DPI-H RA: Smart guidelines](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/smart-guidelines/) |
| <a id="term-digital-adaptation-kit"></a>**Digital adaptation kit (DAK)** | Software-neutral L2 content: personas, workflows, core data dictionary, decision logic, indicators and requirements. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) | 1, 3 | same as [DPI-H RA: Digital adaptation kit](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/digital-adaptation-kit/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: Digital adaptation kits](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/digital-adaptation-kits/) |
| <a id="term-core-data-set"></a>**Core data set** | The elements a country agrees to record for a use case, each mapped to standard codes. Also called a minimum data set. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) | 3 | related [DPI-H RA: National health data dictionary](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/national-health-data-dictionary/)<br/>related [DTH-PHC: Data dictionary](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/data-dictionary/) |
| <a id="term-hl7-fhir"></a>**Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)** | FHIR is a standard for healthcare data exchange, published by HL7® | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/fast-healthcare-interoperability-resources/) |  | same as [DTH-PHC: Fast healthcare interoperability resources](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/fast-healthcare-interoperability-resources/) |
| <a id="term-implementation-guide"></a>**Implementation guide (IG)** | A FHIR specification for one use case: profiles, codes and tests. It can be adopted rather than authored. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Implementation guide](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/implementation-guide/) |
| <a id="term-profile"></a>**Profile** | A FHIR resource tailored to a use case, for example by making some fields required. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-international-patient-summary"></a>**International Patient Summary (IPS)** | A standard minimal health summary, including immunizations, readable across borders. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: International patient summary](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-patient-summary/) |
| <a id="term-international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis"></a>**International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis (ICVP)** | The "yellow card". The digital ICVP is its signed, verifiable form. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: International certificate of vaccination or prophylaxis](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis/) |
| <a id="term-international-health-regulations"></a>**International Health Regulations (IHR)** | International Health Regulations (2005), amended in 2024. The legal basis for the ICVP and other cross-border health documents. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: International health regulations](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-health-regulations/) |
| <a id="term-snomed-ct"></a>**SNOMED CT** | Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms is a structured clinical terminology standard for use in electronic health records. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/snomed-ct/) | 3 | same as [DTH-PHC: Snomed ct](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/snomed-ct/) |
| <a id="term-international-classification-of-diseases"></a>**International Classification of Diseases (ICD)** | WHO's classification; ICD-11 is the current version. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DTH-PHC: International classification of diseases](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/international-classification-of-diseases/)<br/>covers [DPI-H RA: International classification of diseases 11th revision](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-classification-of-diseases-11th-revision/)<br/>covers [DTH-PHC: International classification of diseases 11](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/international-classification-of-diseases-11/) |
| <a id="term-logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes"></a>**Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC)** | LOINC is a common language (a set of identifiers, names, and codes) for identifying health measurements, observations, and documents. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes/) |  | same as [DTH-PHC: Logical observation identifiers names and codes](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes/) |
| <a id="term-openehr"></a>**openEHR** | An open standard for clinical data models (archetypes), often used to store records alongside FHIR for exchange. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-conformance"></a>**Conformance** | Proof that a system implements a specification correctly, usually by passing a test suite. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |

### Trust, credentials and wallets

| Term | Definition | Definition from | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-verifiable-credential"></a>**Verifiable credential (VC)** | A digitally signed statement, such as a vaccination record, that anyone can check is genuine and unaltered. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | close to [SMART Trust: Verifiable Digital Health Certificate](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#verifiable-digital-health-certificate) |
| <a id="term-issuer-holder-verifier"></a>**Issuer · holder · verifier** | The three roles: who signs the credential, who keeps it, and who checks it. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) | 4 | covers [SMART Trust: Issuer](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#issuer)<br/>covers [SMART Trust: Holder](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#holder)<br/>covers [SMART Trust: Receiver](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#receiver) |
| <a id="term-digital-signature"></a>**Digital signature** | A cryptographic seal made with the issuer's private key. Verifiers check it with the matching public key. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | related [SMART Trust: Document Signer](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#document-signer) |
| <a id="term-public-key-infrastructure"></a>**Public key infrastructure (PKI)** | The keys, certificates and rules that make digital signatures trustworthy. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Public key infrastructure](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/public-key-infrastructure/)<br/>same as [SMART Trust: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#public-key-infrastructure-pki) |
| <a id="term-trust-anchor"></a>**Trust anchor** | The national authority whose key vouches for the health sector's signers. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) | 4 | related [SMART Trust: Trust Network Gateway – Trust Anchor](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#trust-network-gateway---trust-anchor--tngta) |
| <a id="term-trust-list"></a>**Trust list** | A published list of keys accepted as valid issuers. The GDHCN shares these between countries. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | close to [SMART Trust: Trust Lists](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#trust-lists) |
| <a id="term-global-digital-health-certification-network"></a>**Global Digital Health Certification Network (GDHCN)** | WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network. A trust network so countries can verify each other's health documents. Countries onboard per use case. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Global digital health certification network](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/global-digital-health-certification-network/)<br/>same as [SMART Trust: GDHCN Trust Network](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#gdhcn-trust-network) |
| <a id="term-digital-wallet"></a>**Digital wallet** | An app where a person holds their credentials. A signed paper QR code can play the same role. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | related [SMART Trust: Holder](https://smart.who.int/trust/concepts.html#holder) |
| <a id="term-digital-documentation-of-covid-19-certificates"></a>**Digital Documentation of COVID-19 Certificates (DDCC)** | WHO's earlier specification; much of its approach carries into the digital ICVP. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-health-certificate-identifier"></a>**Health certificate identifier (HCID)** | The unique ID of an issued certificate. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) | 3 |  |
| <a id="term-consent"></a>**Consent** | A person's permission for their data to be used or shared. Rules for minors and dependants differ by country. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Testing and convergence

| Term | Definition | Definition from | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-sandbox"></a>**Sandbox** | A shared test environment with sample data where systems can try exchanges safely. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-test-suite"></a>**Test suite** | Automated checks of a system against a specification. ITB, the Interoperability Test Bed, is an open tool used for this. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-interoperability-lab"></a>**Interoperability lab** | A standing national or regional facility for conformance testing and building local skills. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-connectathon"></a>**Connectathon** | An event where teams test real systems against a specification together. It exposes gaps fast and builds skills. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) | 5 |  |
| <a id="term-convergence-workshop"></a>**Convergence workshop** | AeHIN's method for aligning a ministry and its partners behind one national architecture and investment plan. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-openfn"></a>**OpenFN** | An open-source integration tool used to connect legacy systems and migrate them to standards. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Governance, planning and financing

| Term | Definition | Definition from | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-digital-health-strategy"></a>**Digital health strategy** | The national vision and priorities for digital health. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-blueprint"></a>**Enterprise Architecture** | The organising logic for business processes and IT infrastructure reflecting the integration and standardisation requirements of the organisation's operating model. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/enterprise-architecture/) |  | close to [DTH-PHC: Enterprise architecture](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/enterprise-architecture/) |
| <a id="term-costed-investment-plan"></a>**Costed investment plan** | A prioritised, costed roadmap from today's systems to the blueprint. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-digital-implementation-investment-guide"></a>**Digital Implementation Investment Guide (DIIG)** | WHO Digital Implementation Investment Guide. Steps to plan, cost and integrate digital health investments. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Digital implementation investment guide](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/digital-implementation-investment-guide/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: Digital implementation investment guide](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/digital-implementation-investment-guide/) |
| <a id="term-technical-working-group"></a>**Technical working group (TWG)** | Coordinates standards and architecture decisions across government and partners. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  | same as [DPI-H RA: Technical working group](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/technical-working-group/) |
| <a id="term-decision-rights"></a>**Decision rights** | Who has authority over architecture, standards, the core data set and the trust anchor. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) | 4 |  |
| <a id="term-procurement-conditions"></a>**Procurement conditions** | Requirements written into tenders, such as conformance to the national IG, that steer what suppliers build. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-total-cost-of-ownership"></a>**Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** | The resources required to support a digital health intervention throughout its life cycle. | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/total-cost-of-ownership/) | 6 |  |
| <a id="term-vendor-lock-in"></a>**Vendor lock-in** | Dependence on one supplier because data formats or interfaces are closed. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Immunization

| Term | Definition | Definition from | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-expanded-programme-on-immunization"></a>**Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI)** | The national immunization programme. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-adverse-event-following-immunization"></a>**Adverse Events Following Immunization (AEFI)** | Adverse effects following immunisation | [DPI-H RA](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/adverse-events-following-immunization/) |  |  |
| <a id="term-dose-number-and-series"></a>**Dose number and series** | Which dose this is, out of how many in the schedule. Needed to work out what is due next. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-batch-number"></a>**Batch number** | Identifies the production batch of a vaccine. Needed for recalls and safety checks. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
| <a id="term-logistics-management-information-system"></a>**Logistics management information system (LMIS)** | Tracks vaccine stock; the cold chain keeps vaccines at the right temperature. | [Handout](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf) |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Sources

The handout: *DPI-H for Health Workshop, Policy-maker track, Glossary: Terms You Will Hear* (2 sides), which cites the WHO/ITU Reference Architecture for DPI-H (Draft v1.0), WHO SMART Guidelines, the digital ICVP specification and the WHO DIIG. The SKOS scheme is `glossary/dpi-h-policy-track.glossary.json`. The dth-phc glossary is linked where litlfred/dth-phc publishes it, until it moves to WorldHealthOrganization/dth-phc.
